title: SAGE Document Types Configuration
description: Defines the doc_type enum for a vault's domain vocabulary. doc_type is the sole Tier 2 (vault-configured) metadata field. See SAGE Architecture Reference Section 4.4.2.

doc_types.description: The set of document type values valid in this vault. Each entry defines a classification in the vault's domain vocabulary.

value.description: Machine identifier for the doc_type. Lowercase, underscore-separated. Used in metadata fields, filename extraction maps, and pipeline stage scoping.

label.description: Human-readable display name for this document type.

description.description: Brief description of what this document type represents in the domain.

source_types.description: Optional constraint restricting this doc_type to files ingested via specific source adapters. When present, filename-based doc_type resolution skips this type for files whose adapter is not in the list. Omit for doc_types valid across all adapters.

metadata_schema.description: Optional JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) fragment validating the structure of `tier3_metadata` payloads for documents of this doc_type. When omitted, this doc_type does not accept `tier3_metadata` (ingest/update with non-null payload returns 400 `tier3_schema_violation`). When present, payloads are validated at the SAGE API boundary on `ingest_document` and `update_metadata`. The fragment is not recursively validated by SAGE; SAGE assumes the author supplied valid JSON Schema. Tier 3 is per-doc_type structured metadata, distinct from Tier 2 (the doc_type vocabulary itself).

unique_keys.description: Optional list of tier3_metadata field names whose values must be unique within this doc_type (CAS-ADR-031); each must name a property in `metadata_schema.properties`. Enforced atomically by the storage substrate on every write; a duplicate raises `tier3_unique_constraint_violation` (409). Every chain head holds its value, archived ones included; only a superseded predecessor is exempt. A declaration is enforced only over a clean portfolio (CAS-ADR-031 §5): adding one whose values already collide is refused with `tier3_unique_activation_blocked`, and while one is unenforced a write setting its field is refused with `tier3_unique_constraint_inactive`. Clean declarations are enforced from the config write, on vault load and by `migrate_vault`.
